reviewed_claims: Single busy action prevents request/application double-click replay.
Request IDs and persisted GET reconciliation recover unknown start acknowledgement without automatic inference retries.
Apply fences later editor input, rights/response intent changes and record navigation; selections retain their captured revisions and cached release proofs are invalidated.
Pagehide fences pending polling/model results and clears timers; pageshow explicitly refreshes persisted jobs.
Draft application is separate from manual review, and atomic record/history/proposal receipt updates are revision/source-hash checked.
Browser scenario uses real local HTTP and actual downloaded ZIP consumption by unchanged pinned imagefolder validator; frozen manifest retains target proposal linkage.
Existing CI command sequence is preserved; new syntax/controller/browser gates and unique ignored browser output collection are registered.
limits: Did not run browsers or aggregate suite: parent owns concurrent qualification.
Reviewed browser/Python assertions and consumer source, but did not independently execute those paths.
No remote calls, real models, credentials, downloads, repository/source/report edits or publication.
Controlled provider fixtures establish protocol/lifecycle behavior; no real-model vision compatibility or caption semantic-quality conclusion.
